case: AIR, SEA, RID, other modes
required_evidence_or_resolution: Mode-specific regulatory source and packaging conditions

case: Emerging pathogen with no severity judgement
required_evidence_or_resolution: Professional assessment of exposure form and Cat A criteria

case: Category A indicative list cultures only ambiguity
required_evidence_or_resolution: Confirm culture vs patient specimen and current pathogenic form

case: E. coli verotoxigenic, M. tuberculosis, Shigella dysenteriae type 1 diagnostic cultures
required_evidence_or_resolution: Determine allowable Cat B discretion under table footnote a

case: Unidentified Category A source evidence
required_evidence_or_resolution: Source history, symptoms, endemic setting, human/animal effects; SP318 documentation

case: Minimal-risk specimen with alternate packaging
required_evidence_or_resolution: Independent proof no leakage, proper mark and appropriate mode requirements

case: Specimen insufficient absorbent or mark
required_evidence_or_resolution: Verified package compliance; do not infer Category B

case: Waste catalogue code 18 01 03 or 18 02 02 without medical diagnosis
required_evidence_or_resolution: Clinical/veterinary diagnosis required by 2.2.62.1.11.1 Note2

case: Conflicting waste code/low risk and Category A report
required_evidence_or_resolution: Reconcile contradictory evidence before exemption

case: UN3549 vs UN2814 or UN2900 for eligible solid Category A waste
required_evidence_or_resolution: Optional UN3549 plus SP395; actual chosen Table A row

case: Infected intentionally live animal
required_evidence_or_resolution: Authority approval conditions; alternative means; national animal rules

case: Unintentionally or naturally infected live animal
required_evidence_or_resolution: Origin, transit, destination rules

case: Other hazardous properties of material, waste, devices, biological products
required_evidence_or_resolution: Cross-class assessment and precedence

case: Unknown licensed biological product restrictions
required_evidence_or_resolution: National manufacture/packaging and local competent authority controls

case: P650 relief under SP319
required_evidence_or_resolution: Packaging and marking compliance audit; not automatic from UN3373 candidate

case: SP318 technical name and suspected Category A transport document
required_evidence_or_resolution: Verify technical identity and document text

case: Class6.2 Table A row variants, refrigeration, animal material
required_evidence_or_resolution: Explicit row selection and Part4/5/7 implications

case: ADR corrigenda, later editions and UN test manual amendment
required_evidence_or_resolution: Reconcile Corr.1 and Corr.2 and supporting test manuals

case: Global not-regulated / full SDS Section14
required_evidence_or_resolution: ADR scope, other classes, named entries, SPs and TableA

case: CLP/GHS-only safety data
required_evidence_or_resolution: Independent ADR infectious hazard evidence
